subject.name: Ship Engineers
subject.summary: On this page, ship engineers specifically means onboard engineering positions under O*NET 53-5031: monitoring main engines, boilers, generators, pumps, and related systems; organizing engine-room watches, maintenance, and fault responses; and reporting irregularities to the captain and shore personnel. This is distinct from marine engineers and naval architects responsible for hull design; specific seagoing engineering duties require verification of certificates of competency, trading areas, and equipment classes.
